title: Classical derived pullback on chosen resolution sections
statement: Let $g:X^{\prime}\to X$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $G$ an abelian sheaf on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $q\in\mathbb N$. Let $L=g^{-1}$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-inverse-image], $\Gamma=\Gamma(X,-)$, and $\Gamma^{\prime}=\Gamma(X^{\prime},-)$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology]. Write $s:G[0]\to I$ and $t:(LG)[0]\to J$ for the chosen injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $\varphi:LI\to J$ be a chain map with $L(s);\varphi$ homotopic to the composite of the canonical single-complex isomorphism $L(G[0])\cong (LG)[0]$ and $t$. Let $\eta:\Gamma\to L\Gamma^{\prime}$ be the unit section map followed by $\Gamma(X,g_*(-))\cong\Gamma(X^{\prime},-)$, and let $b=\eta(I);\Gamma^{\prime}(\varphi)$. Let $c_{X,G,q}:R^q\Gamma(G)\xrightarrow{\sim}H^q(\Gamma(I))$ be the canonical InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex comparison, and similarly $c_{X^{\prime},LG,q}$. Set $e:\Gamma\circ\mathrm{id}\to L\Gamma^{\prime}$ equal to the right unitor followed by $\eta$. Then $c_{X,G,q};H^q(b)=\operatorname{rightDerivedBaseChange}(e,q)_G;c_{X^{\prime},LG,q}$. This computes just the classical map and contains no Ext comparison or Ext pullback assertion.

proof.text: Evaluate rightDerivedFunctorPlusBaseChange_fac at the bounded below source resolution. Naturality of mapDerivedCategoryPlusIdIso cancels the identity-functor factorization, giving the levelwise section transformation followed by the target derived unit. This is the private proved helper resolution_baseChange_unit.

Apply resolution_pullback_augmentation to the supplied lift and homotopy. Naturality of base change along the source augmentation and naturality of the target derived unit along the lift identify the derived base-change map, conjugated by the chosen resolution isomorphisms, with Q of the section map. Cancel the source and target units on injective complexes. This is the proved representative calculation inside resolution_baseChange_sections.

Expand rightDerivedBaseChange_app and the canonical single-functor homology comparisons. Use identityDerivedHomologyComparison to identify the identity exact-functor comparison. Apply homology to the representative equation, cancel the resolution isomorphisms, and use homologyFunctorObjQIso_hom_naturality. The surviving comparison is exactly isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex. Specialize to the etale section functors and exact upperStar.

lean.statement: theorem classicalPullback_resolution_sections {X X' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : X' ⟶ X) (G : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) (q : ℕ) (φ : ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (injectiveResolution G).cochainComplex ⟶ (injectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').obj G)).cochainComplex) (hφ : Nonempty (Homotopy (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map (injectiveResolution G).ι' ≫ φ) ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g') (.up ℤ) 0).hom.app G ≫ (injectiveResolution ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').obj G)).ι'))) : let Γ := Sheaf.Γ X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} let Γ' := Sheaf.Γ X'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} let L := upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g' let η : Γ ⟶ L ⋙ Γ' := (Functor.leftUnitor Γ).inv ≫ Functor.whiskerRight (upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').unit Γ ≫ (Functor.associator _ _ _).hom ≫ Functor.whiskerLeft L (lowerStarCompGlobalSectionsIso AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} g').hom let b := (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex η (.up ℤ)).app (injectiveResolution G).cochainComplex ≫ (Γ'.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).map φ let e : Γ ⋙ 𝟭 _ ⟶ L ⋙ Γ' := (Functor.rightUnitor Γ).hom ≫ η ((injectiveResolution G).isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex Γ q).hom ≫ HomologicalComplex.homologyMap b (q : ℤ) = (Functor.rightDerivedBaseChange e q).app G ≫ ((injectiveResolution (L.obj G)).isoRightDerivedObjCochainComplex Γ' q).hom
